description: Public datasets of evoked responses. Every value is taken from the literature review of the specification (docs/spec/LITERATURE.md, datasets axis, and docs/spec/GAPS.md); null means the value is not stated there.

fields.sfreq: sampling frequency in Hz stated for the dataset (runs may differ)
fields.size_gb: size of the whole dataset in GB
fields.events_status: present | absent | unknown: stimulation or stimulus events in the files
fields.loader: evoparam function that reads the dataset, or null
fields.files: path inside the dataset -> SHA-256, checked by fetch_openneuro_file

datasets.title: CCEP ECoG dataset across age 4-51

datasets.title: Single-pulse open-loop TMS-EEG dataset
quirks: minimal metadata
NEMAR mirror on002094 (DOI 10.82901/nemar.on002094)
licence, sampling rate, subjects, size and events read from the dataset files on 2026-10-08 (dataset_description.json: License CC0; no DOI given)
600 single TMS pulses per subject over the right motor cortex at 120 % of the resting motor threshold (sourcedata/README.txt), markers R128; 30 scalp EEG channels, reference POz, BrainVision float32
task tmseeg1, plus tmseeg2 for sub-728, sub-766 and sub-780 (to be read after tmseeg1); the README removes EEG trials 1-2 of sub-767, after 556 of sub-774 and 401-405 of sub-780
recordings are paused between blocks: several New Segment markers per run
task rest (no TMS) and EMG and neuronavigation files in sourcedata

datasets.title: Dataset of intracranial EEG during cortical stimulations evoking negative motor responses
ERP CORE
quirks: seven components in six paradigms, with published pipelines and scores
a Python fetcher exists (hu-neuro-pipeline, pipeline.datasets.get_erpcore)

epoched files after the published pipeline: <component>/<participant>/*_epoch_interp_ar.set (OSF nodes etdkz P3, pfde9 N170, 29xpq N400, 5q4xs MMN, yefrq N2pc, 28e6c LRP, q6gwp ERN); OSF throttles downloads to about 110 kB/s per connection (2026-10-08)

ground truth for source localization

datasets.title: bigP3BCI
quirks: brain-computer interface data with single-trial ERPs (GAPS.md, GAP-33)

datasets.title: Allen Visual Coding - Neuropixels
quirks: the only large, fully open, NWB-formatted source of sensory-evoked LFP
distributed through DANDI
DANDI 000021: one session file (stimulus tables) and one file per probe (LFP); read remotely by byte ranges
LFP timestamps can have gaps (session 715093703, probe 810755797: 831 to 1846 s, over the flashes); read_nwb drops the events inside a gap
